summary: Verified bug fix: transcription result now appears on main screen after background job completes. Backend: POST /api/transcribe returns job_id+processing immediately (<15s), GET /api/jobs/{id} polls to done with full record; GET /api/history & 404 cases pass. Frontend: uploaded test tone, clicked Транскрибировать, processing-progress-bar appeared, placeholder 'Результат транскрибации появится здесь' disappeared and transcript-workbench (with segments/full-text tabs, duration/segments metrics, TXT/SRT/JSON download buttons) rendered on main screen within ~25s. History drawer also shows the new record (6 items). No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: BackgroundTasks + db.jobs pattern is fine for single-instance deployments; for multi-replica consider a proper task queue (Celery/RQ).
No TTL/cleanup for db.jobs — successful job docs accumulate indefinitely; add a TTL index or cleanup task.
Frontend poll never times out — if backend keeps returning errors forever, UI stays in 'processing'. Consider max poll duration (e.g. 10 min) with timeout toast.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test_tone.mp3 jobs/records; backend test cleans up via DELETE /api/history/{id}. UI test created 1 extra history row (expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Async transcribe + polling flow verified end-to-end. 4/4 pytest green. Modulate real latency for 3s tone was ~15-20s in this run.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: synchronous POST /api/transcribe exceeded gateway timeout (~30s) while real Modulate takes 40-60s. Backend still persisted the record to db.transcriptions, so it only showed up in History. Fix: switched to BackgroundTasks + GET /api/jobs/{id} polling; frontend polls every 2.5s and calls setRecord(job.record) on 'done', which renders TranscriptWorkbench. Verified: placeholder before=True, after=False; workbench visible with all data-testids.
